title: An erase can drop another device's new reminders token adopted during its prepare's await, leaving that row live
evidence: Found during S59. cancelRemindersForErase (widget-src/standalone/reminders.ts:375-391) reads the opt-in at :378 and then awaits cancelProofFor at :379. The erase adopts any active opt-in from the stored and device copies before it (packages/health-core/src/record-session-erase.ts:97-108), then runs beforeErase (:109), then builds the erased file (:113), which holds no opt-in. If a remote adopt lands during the :379 await and brings another device's new reminders token, the prepare still holds the old token, the commit cancels only that one, and the erase drops the new token from the file. That device's server row stays live and its reminders keep going until its email unsubscribe link is used. The same window existed before PR 1674 (the teardown ran in the same place). First confirm an adopt can land while erasing (record-session.ts:209 refuses some work while saveMode is erasing). Fix options: re-read the opt-in after the await and cancel every active token seen; or take the token from the merged file the erase builds from. US-11 AC2, AC4c.
